why: Both proposals have the same warm palette: dark wood bookcase and table, a light jute rug and natural textiles. A's two side-by-side bookcases give 180 cm of tall dark-wood shelving that fills a good part of the left wall as the client asked, while B's single 90 cm unit falls short of that main request; B's cognac leather chair and swing-arm reading lamp are good picks, but they don't make up for it.
